tests.description: ONE_INDOOR board is correctly identified at boot
tests.expected_result: Serial log contains "Detected ONE_INDOOR". OLED splash proceeds with the ONE_INDOOR boot sequence: LED-test prompt first, then offline-mode prompt later.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Power-cycle with USB serial attached.

tests.description: OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR board is correctly identified at boot
tests.expected_result: Serial log contains "Detected OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR".
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Open Air has no display, so this test is log-only.

tests.description: ONE_INDOOR reports firmware model 'I-9PSL'
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Version: ..." (no "Firmware Mode" line on indoor). mDNS TXT record carries model="I-9PSL". POST payload does not include a model field.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + mDNS browser (e.g. avahi-browse). Single firmware-model string for all ONE_INDOOR units.

tests.description: Open Air with PMS5003T + S8 + SGP41 reports 'O-1PST'
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Mode: O-1PST". Both S8 and SGP41 init succeed; single PM sensor detected.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + unit populated with all three sensors. Most common Open Air SKU.

tests.description: Open Air with two PMS5003T + SGP41 (no S8) reports 'O-1PPT'
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Mode: O-1PPT". Log contains "Can not detect S8 run mode 'PPT'". SGP41 init succeeds. PM detection on both Serial0 and Serial1 succeeds.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + unit without S8, two PM channels, SGP41.

tests.description: Open Air with two PMS5003T but no SGP41 and no S8 reports 'O-1PP'
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Mode: O-1PP". Logs include "Can not detect SGP run mode 'O-1PP'".
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + unit with two PM channels only. If only one PM channel responds, mode auto-downgrades to O-1P.

tests.description: Open Air with PMS5003T + S8 (no SGP41) reports the O-1PS firmware mode
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Mode: 0-1PS" (digit zero, known typo) and "Can not detect SGP run mode 'O-1PS'".
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + unit with S8 but no SGP41. The "0-1PS" string is a typo in AgFirmwareModeName() at src/App/AppDef.cpp:14; when fixed, expected becomes "O-1PS".

tests.description: Open Air with only one PMS5003T reports 'O-1P'
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Firmware Mode: O-1P". Reached only by downgrade from O-1PP when exactly one of the two PM channels responds.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Reproduce by populating only one PM channel on an O-1PP-style board (no S8, no SGP41). No code path enters O-1P directly at first detection.

tests.description: On ONE_INDOOR, SPS30 is used as fallback when PMS5003 is absent
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "PMS5003 not found, trying SPS30..." followed by "SPS30 detected on Serial0" and a serial-number print. Subsequent PM measurements are produced (non-zero, valid).
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + ONE_INDOOR unit with SPS30 in place of PMS5003. Detection order per port is PMS5003 first, SPS30 fallback.

tests.description: On Open Air, SPS30 is used per-channel as fallback when PMS5003T is absent
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "PMS5003T not found on Serial0/Serial1, trying SPS30..." then "Detected SPS30 on <port>". Firmware mode string is unchanged (still O-1P* family). Both channels in PPT/PP modes can each be either PMS5003T or SPS30 independently.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + Open Air with at least one SPS30 in place of PMS5003T.

tests.description: When neither PMS5003 nor SPS30 are present, device boots without crashing
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "SPS30 not found either" (indoor) or "No PM sensor detected on <port>" (outdoor). On ONE_INDOOR OLED shows "PM sensor" not detected. Device continues boot; PM fields are absent from POST payload and shown as "-" on OLED.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Pull the PM sensor cable to reproduce. Verifies graceful degradation.

tests.description: OLED shows "sensor not detected" message when CO2 S8 is absent
tests.expected_result: OLED splash displays "S8 not detected" (or equivalent). Log shows "CO2 S8 sensor not found". CO2 field absent from POST, shown as "-" on OLED at runtime.
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + serial log. Unplug S8 to reproduce.

tests.description: OLED shows "sensor not detected" message when SGP41 is absent
tests.expected_result: OLED splash displays "SGP41 not detected" (or equivalent). Serial log shows "Init SGP41 failure". TVOC/NOx fields absent from POST, shown as "-" on OLED at runtime.
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + serial log. Unplug SGP41 to reproduce.

tests.description: OLED shows firmware version during boot
tests.expected_result: Firmware version string (e.g. "3.6.6") visible on OLED during the boot splash sequence and matches the version printed in the serial log ("Firmware Version: ...").
tests.notes: Requires: OLED. Compare with the version of the binary flashed; useful sanity-check that the right artifact landed.

tests.description: OLED shows the monitor serial number during boot
tests.expected_result: Device serial number / ID visible on OLED warming-up screen and matches serial log "Serial nr: <id>". Cross-checkable via /measures/current field "serialno" (NOT exposed via /config).
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + LAN access to /measures/current (for cross-check).

tests.description: If httpDomain is configured, OLED indicates a custom server target during boot
tests.expected_result: When httpDomain is non-empty in config, OLED shows the three-line message "HTTP domain name" / "using local" / "configuration" and serial log prints "HTTP domain name is set to: <domain>". When empty/unset, no custom-domain OLED message is shown.
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + serial log. Set httpDomain via /config PUT or cloud, then reboot.

tests.description: Network option is set to Cellular when CE card is attached, otherwise WiFi
tests.expected_result: With cellular module plugged in: serial log shows "Cellular module found" and cellular init proceeds. Without cellular module: serial log shows "Cellular module not available, using wifi" and the WiFi provisioning flow runs.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Test both physical configurations of the same firmware build (with and without CE card).

tests.description: OLED shows "client initialization failed" when cellular fails to attach to network
tests.expected_result: When the CE module is present but cannot connect (no SIM / no signal / bad credentials), OLED shows "client initialization failed" (or equivalent).
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + cellular module with no SIM or out-of-coverage.

tests.description: After network is up at boot, device fetches configuration from server
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows GET to /sensors/airgradient:<serial>/one/config with response 200 when registered or 400 when not registered. Configuration values are applied to runtime state when fetch and parse succeed.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + working network. Must complete before runtime begins.

tests.description: On WiFi, the boot POST contains only boot count and wifi signal
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows a POST measures with minimal JSON payload containing only keys "boot" and "wifi".
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + WiFi network. Distinct from steady-state POSTs which include all sensor fields.

tests.description: On Cellular, the boot POST is sent after a ~20s delay and carries a full measurement cycle
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Prepare first measures cycle to send on boot for 20s", then ~20s later "New measurement cycle added to queue", followed by a cellular CSV POST (interval, current measurement fields, cellular signal).
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular network. Unlike WiFi, cellular boot POST carries a full measurement cycle, not a hello payload. Timing approximate (±5s).

tests.description: At boot, device performs an OTA availability check
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows OTA check executing once at boot inside the networking task. Outcome (304 / 200 / skip / error) is logged. If 200, the update flow is initiated (see OTA Update category).
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + network. First of the recurring (every 1 hour) OTA checks. On WiFi, may run after the boot POST, so not strictly the first server communication.

tests.description: Dashboard refreshes on a fixed interval
tests.expected_result: Dashboard re-renders every 2500 ms (DISP_UPDATE_INTERVAL). Value changes from sensors become visible within one refresh tick.
tests.notes: Easiest to observe by watching the AddToDashboard / DeviceId alternation (5 s) which is implicitly driven by these refresh ticks.

tests.description: Cloud icon appears top-right when post-measures is failing
tests.expected_result: When post-measures fails and state becomes AgStateMachineServerLost, the dashboard shows the cloud-issue icon (14×11 px) at top-right. Fetch-config failure uses AgStateMachineSensorConfigFailed, not this cloud icon.
tests.notes: Reproduce after the device is registered: keep postDataToAirGradient=true and make the AG measures endpoint unreachable (e.g. firewall rule on the router). The matching LED-bar colour is covered in the LED bar category.

tests.description: WiFi icon appears top-right when the network link is lost
tests.expected_result: When WiFi disconnects, or when in cellular mode the client reports not-ready, state becomes AgStateMachineWiFiLost and the dashboard shows the wifi-issue icon (14×11 px) at top-right. Icon clears once the connection / client-ready state recovers.
tests.notes: Reproduce on WiFi by powering off the AP or moving out of range; on cellular by pulling the SIM or removing the CE module.

tests.description: Plane icon appears top-right when device is in offline mode
tests.expected_result: In offline mode the dashboard shows the offline plane icon (14×14 px) at top-right. Icon persists for the entire offline session.
tests.notes: Enter offline mode via the short-press prompt at boot. Plane icon is the visual marker that post / fetch / OTA schedules are suppressed.

tests.description: Unregistered device alternates between 'Add To Dashboard' and serial number
tests.expected_result: When fetch-config returns 400 (device not on any dashboard), the central area of the screen alternates every 5 s between the text "Add To Dashboard" and the device serial number.
tests.notes: Reproduce with a fresh device that has never been linked to an account. State AgStateMachineSensorConfigFailed drives this; alternation stops once the device is added.

tests.description: CO2 cell shows '-' when CO2 reading is invalid
tests.expected_result: CO2 column displays "-" (in place of a number) and the "ppm" unit label remains visible. No crash, dashboard keeps refreshing.
tests.notes: Reproduce by unplugging the S8 or by forcing 3 consecutive invalid reads. PM2.5, VOC and NOx have analogous behaviour (see their own tests).

tests.description: PM2.5 cell shows '-' when PM2.5 reading is invalid
tests.expected_result: PM2.5 column displays "-" in place of the number and the unit label ("AQI" or "ug/m³" depending on pmStandard) stays visible.
tests.notes: Reproduce by unplugging the PM sensor or by forcing 6 consecutive invalid reads.

tests.description: VOC and NOx cells show '-' when their reading is invalid
tests.expected_result: VOC and NOx rows in the right-hand column show "-" individually when their respective index is invalid. Labels "VOC:" and "NOx:" remain visible.
tests.notes: Reproduce by unplugging the SGP41 or by forcing 12 consecutive invalid reads. Applies only when ledBarMode != iaqs (otherwise this column is replaced by the IAQS panel).

tests.description: Temperature and humidity headers show '-°C/F' and '-%' when invalid
tests.expected_result: Top-of-screen temperature reading is rendered as "-°C" (or "-°F" if temperatureUnit=F). Humidity reading is rendered as "-%". Layout stays intact.
tests.notes: Reproduce by unplugging the SHT or by forcing 2 consecutive invalid reads.

tests.description: PM2.5 column reflects pmStandard config (AQI vs ug/m³)
tests.expected_result: When pmStandard = "us-aqi" the PM2.5 value is the US AQI conversion and the unit label reads "AQI". When pmStandard = "ugm3" the raw concentration is shown with unit "ug/m³".
tests.notes: Switch the value via /config PUT or cloud, observe within one refresh tick.

tests.description: Temperature header reflects temperatureUnit config (C vs F)
tests.expected_result: When temperatureUnit ∈ {"c", "C"} the temperature is shown in Celsius with the "°C" suffix. When ∈ {"f", "F"} the value is converted and the suffix is "°F".
tests.notes: Conversion happens only at the display layer; raw value remains in Celsius internally and in /measures/current.

tests.description: PM2.5 displayed value is the corrected value when PM correction is enabled
tests.expected_result: When PM correction is enabled and SHT is present, the PM2.5 cell shows the corrected PM2.5 value rounded to an integer. In ugm3 mode it matches rounded /measures/current pm02Compensated; in us-aqi mode it matches that value after AQI conversion.
tests.notes: Cross-check via /measures/current pm02Compensated (already int-rounded). Without SHT the display shows the raw value regardless of correction setting.

tests.description: Temperature and humidity headers show corrected values when their correction is enabled
tests.expected_result: When temperature/humidity correction is enabled, the header shows corrected values: temperature rounded to 1 decimal, humidity rounded to an integer. Fahrenheit conversion is applied after correction.
tests.notes: Humidity matches /measures/current rhumCompensated (integer). For temperature, /measures/current atmpCompensated is integer-rounded and coarser than the displayed 1-decimal value — use the POST-payload tempCompensated (2 decimals) for a precision-faithful check.

tests.description: IAQS panel replaces VOC/NOx column when ledBarMode = iaqs
tests.expected_result: Right-hand column shows three rows: header "IAQS", a numeric score with a single grade letter to its right, and a dominant pollutant line ("PM", "CO2" or "BOTH") prefixed by a right-pointing arrow. VOC/NOx labels are no longer rendered.
tests.notes: Set ledBarMode = "iaqs" via /config PUT. Score/grade/dominant computed from current PM2.5 and CO2 averages (PM2.5 uses corrected value when SHT + PM correction enabled).

tests.description: IAQS panel shows '-' when CO2 or PM2.5 is invalid
tests.expected_result: With ledBarMode = iaqs, if either CO2 or PM2.5 average is invalid, the score area shows a single centred "-" and no grade letter or dominant-pollutant row is rendered.
tests.notes: IAQS score is computed from both pollutants, so either one being invalid invalidates the score.

tests.description: OLED shows 'CE error since 2h / Rebooting in N' when device gives up on cellular
tests.expected_result: When CE client problems persist for ~2 hours, the screen shows two lines "CE error" / "since 2h" plus a one-line countdown "Rebooting in 3" → "2" → "1" (1 second per step), then the device reboots and the display is blanked (brightness 0) just before reboot.
tests.notes: Requires: cellular module + induced fault (e.g. SIM pulled, no service) for at least 2 hours. Hard to test in normal QA; can be deferred to a long-soak fixture.

tests.description: LED bar stays dark when ledBarMode = off
tests.expected_result: All 11 LEDs are off in steady state. The LED bar is disabled (ledBar.setEnable(false)), so fault notification overlays are also not physically shown while ledBarMode="off" or brightness is 0. Setting persists across power cycles until changed.
tests.notes: Set ledBarMode = "off" via /config PUT or cloud. ledBar.show() is a no-op once the bar is disabled.

tests.description: LED bar reflects CO2 level when ledBarMode = co2
tests.expected_result: Number of lit LEDs and colour track CO2 average: 1 green (≤600 ppm), 2 green (≤800), 3 yellow (≤1000), 4 orange (≤1250), 5 orange (≤1500), 6 red (≤1750), 7 red (≤2000), 8 purple (≤3000), 9 alternating purple/red (>3000). LEDs are lit from the right end leftwards.
tests.notes: Set ledBarMode = "co2" via /config. Easiest reproduction: breathe near the S8 to push CO2 up through the thresholds and watch the bar grow.

tests.description: LED bar reflects PM2.5 level when ledBarMode = pm
tests.expected_result: Number of lit LEDs and colour track the PM2.5 average: 1–2 green (≤9 µg/m³), 3–4 yellow (≤35), 5–6 orange (≤55), 7–8 red (≤125), 9 purple (≤225), 9 alternating purple/red (>225). LEDs are lit from the right end leftwards. When SHT + PM correction is enabled, the corrected PM2.5 drives the mapping.
tests.notes: Set ledBarMode = "pm" via /config. Reproduce by puffing smoke near the PM sensor or by injecting a high test value via a mock.

tests.description: LED bar shows IAQS score with 1:1 LED-to-score mapping when ledBarMode = iaqs
tests.expected_result: ledsLit = 11 − totalScore. Score 10 → 1 LED lit (LED at the right end); score 0 → all 11 LEDs lit. All lit LEDs share one colour drawn from the IAQS category (Good / Moderate / Unhealthy). Serial log includes "GO IAQS = <total> [pm25 score X, co2 score Y, leds Z]" on each refresh.
tests.notes: Set ledBarMode = "iaqs" via /config. Score is computed from CO2 and PM2.5 averages (PM2.5 uses corrected value when SHT + correction enabled).

tests.description: Leftmost LED turns red when WiFi (or cellular client) is lost
tests.expected_result: In enabled non-IAQS modes (co2 or pm with brightness >0), LED 0 is painted red (255,0,0) on top of the current sensor bar. In IAQS mode, the bar is cleared and only LED 0 lights red. If ledBarMode=off or brightness=0, the overlay is not physically shown.
tests.notes: Same state (AgStateMachineWiFiLost) is triggered by WiFi disconnect OR cellular client-not-ready (see OLED status-icon test for reproduction).

tests.description: Leftmost LED turns orange when post-measures fails
tests.expected_result: In enabled non-IAQS modes (co2 or pm with brightness >0), LED 0 is painted orange (233,183,54). In IAQS mode, the bar is cleared and only LED 0 lights orange. If ledBarMode=off or brightness=0, the overlay is not physically shown. Triggered by AgStateMachineServerLost.
tests.notes: Reproduce by registering the device, then blocking only the measures POST endpoint while leaving fetch-config reachable.

tests.description: Leftmost LED turns violet when device is not yet registered on the dashboard
tests.expected_result: In enabled non-IAQS modes (co2 or pm with brightness >0), LED 0 is painted violet (139,24,248). In IAQS mode, the bar is cleared and only LED 0 lights violet. If ledBarMode=off or brightness=0, the overlay is not physically shown. Triggered by AgStateMachineSensorConfigFailed (fetch-config returned 400).
tests.notes: Reproduce with a fresh device that has never been linked to any dashboard. Pairs with the OLED "Add To Dashboard / Serial" alternation.

tests.description: LED self-test runs on button press during the boot prompt
tests.expected_result: If the button is pressed during the 3-second "Press now for LED test" boot prompt, the bar cycles full-red → full-green → full-blue → full-white → off, 1 s per colour, while OLED shows "LED Test running .....". If no button press, the self-test is skipped. OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR has no boot-prompt self-test path.
tests.notes: Distinct from the server-triggered LED test via ledBarTestRequested config flag, which can run at any time.

tests.description: Setting ledBarTestRequested triggers the self-test
tests.expected_result: When ledBarTestRequested is set to true via /config PUT or cloud, the same self-test sequence runs once (RGBW + off on ONE_INDOOR; 100 blinks on OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR). The flag is consumed after the test runs.
tests.notes: On ONE_INDOOR the OLED shows "LED Test running" while the test is active. Independent of the boot-time prompt path (see led.boot-prompt tests).

tests.description: When country = TH, the requested LED bar test loops for 2 minutes
tests.expected_result: With country = "TH" in config and ledBarTestRequested = true, the RGBW + off sequence loops continuously until 2 minutes have elapsed, then exits with log "LED test after 2 min finish". For any other country code, the sequence runs once.
tests.notes: Set country = "TH" via /config first. Behavior is country-specific only on ONE_INDOOR; Open Air ignores country here.

tests.description: Short-press during 'Press now for LED test' prompt runs the test and skips WiFi provisioning
tests.expected_result: A short press during the OLED "Press now for LED test" prompt enters the LED test path; once the test completes the device enters offline mode and the WiFi provisioning flow is NOT started.
tests.notes: Pressing the back button at this prompt is the documented way to enter offline mode on first boot.

tests.description: Holding the button through the LED test triggers connect to airgradient:cleanair
tests.expected_result: Holding the back button continuously from the "Press now for LED test" prompt until the test completes makes the device join the WiFi SSID "airgradient" with password "cleanair" instead of running the normal provisioning portal.
tests.notes: Hold the back button continuously from the "Press now for LED test" prompt until the test completes. Firmware calls WiFi.begin("airgradient", "cleanair"), shows "Configure WiFi / connect to / 'airgradient'", then reboots. The LED-test prompt runs before the offline-mode prompt, so previous offline-mode state does not block this path.

tests.description: LED bar reflects each WiFi provisioning state on ONE_INDOOR
tests.expected_result: WiFiManagerMode: middle LED solid blue. WiFiManagerPortalActive: all LEDs solid blue (0,0,255). StaConnecting: single white LED running animation. StaConnected: all LEDs solid white. ServerConnecting: single green LED running animation. ServerConnected: all LEDs solid green (0,255,0). WiFiManagerConnectFailed: all LEDs solid red (255,0,0). ServerConnectFailed: all LEDs solid orange (233,183,54). SensorConfigFailed (boot path): all LEDs solid violet (139,24,248).
tests.notes: Walk through provisioning end-to-end: open the portal, enter wrong creds (red), correct creds with unreachable server (orange), correct creds with reachable but un-registered server (violet), then the happy path (green).

tests.description: Status LED reflects provisioning state on Open Air
tests.expected_result: WiFiManagerMode: stepped blink pattern (setStep: ON, OFF, ON, OFF×7 — a double-flash with long gap, repeating). PortalActive: solid on. StaConnecting / StaConnected / ServerConnecting: off. ServerConnected: 2 slow blinks then off. WiFiManagerConnectFailed: 3 bursts of 3 fast blinks (with 2 s gaps). ServerConnectFailed: 3 bursts of 4 fast blinks. SensorConfigFailed: 3 bursts of 5 fast blinks. Runtime WiFiLost / ServerLost / SensorConfigFailed: off.
tests.notes: Open Air has no LED bar, only a single status LED. Burst count is the distinguishing signal: 3 = WiFi creds bad, 4 = server unreachable, 5 = device not on dashboard.

tests.description: When no WiFi credentials are stored, device first tries the default network airgradient/cleanair
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Connected WiFi is empty, connect to default wifi \"airgradient\"". Device waits up to 15 seconds for the connection. If successful, provisioning portal is NOT started. If unsuccessful, log shows "Try connect to default wifi \"airgradient\" failed" and the dual portal/BLE provisioning starts.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + factory-reset device (no saved credentials). The default network exists primarily to support the long-press boot path that sets up an airgradient SSID.

tests.description: WiFi AP portal exposes a per-device SSID with the cleanair password
tests.expected_result: When provisioning starts, the device becomes a WiFi AP with SSID "airgradient-<deviceId>" and password "cleanair". Joining the AP from a phone or laptop opens the captive WiFiManager portal at the gateway IP.
tests.notes: Requires: a phone or laptop that can join the AP. SSID is also visible via the OLED on ONE_INDOOR.

tests.description: OLED shows AP portal SSID, countdown, and blinking BLE label
tests.expected_result: First frame: middle of screen shows "to WiFi hotspot:" and "airgradient-<deviceId>". Top line shows "<N>s to connect" with N decrementing once per second from 180. Bottom-right corner shows "BLE" text that toggles on/off once per second (visible on even-numbered countdown values).
tests.notes: Requires: OLED. Decrement rate is 1 Hz; the "BLE" blink is the visual cue that BLE provisioning is also available simultaneously.

tests.description: AP portal reboots the device after the 180s timeout if no credentials are submitted
tests.expected_result: If 180 seconds elapse without successful WiFi credentials being saved, the WiFiManager timeout callback fires (connectorTimeout=true). After the connect() routine returns, OneOpenAir.ino shows the rebooting screen (ONE_INDOOR) and calls ESP.restart().
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + 3+ minute window with the portal up and no submission. Easiest to verify by walking away.

tests.description: After credentials are submitted, the device waits up to 30s for the WiFi STA to connect
tests.expected_result: On submit, the state changes to WiFiManagerStaConnecting (LED/OLED "Trying to connect to WiFi"). If STA does not connect within 30 seconds (WIFI_PROVISION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SEC), the state changes to WiFiManagerConnectFailed and OLED shows "WiFi not connected".
tests.notes: Requires: ability to inject bad credentials at the portal (or block the target AP mid-handshake).

tests.description: If the submitted credentials never bring up WiFi, the device reboots after the failure indicator
tests.expected_result: After WiFiManagerConnectFailed is shown for ~6 seconds, the connect() routine exits with WiFi still disconnected. OneOpenAir.ino then prints "Failed connect to WiFi", shows the rebooting screen on ONE_INDOOR, and calls ESP.restart().
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + a WiFi network whose credentials look valid in the portal but never actually associate (e.g. wrong password, hidden SSID typo).

tests.description: AP portal exposes a 'Prevent Connection to AirGradient Server' checkbox that persists
tests.expected_result: The portal shows a checkbox labelled "Prevent Connection to AirGradient Server". When checked and submitted, the device sets disableCloudConnection=true and logs "Setting disableCloudConnection set from False to True successful". Subsequent reboots skip AG server traffic (fetch-config, post-measures, OTA) but keep local-server endpoints (mDNS, /config, /measures/current, /metrics).
tests.notes: Requires: a fresh provisioning session with the checkbox toggled. The setting is also reachable via /config PUT disableCloudConnection after onboarding.

tests.description: BLE advertises a Device Information service with model, serial, fw version, and manufacturer
tests.expected_result: BLE device advertises name "AirGradient". Connecting (e.g. via nRF Connect) exposes service 0x180A with characteristics: 0x2A24 Model = current firmware-model string (e.g. "I-9PSL"), 0x2A25 Serial = device ID, 0x2A26 FW version = firmware version string, 0x2A29 Manufacturer = "AirGradient".
tests.notes: Requires: BLE phone/scanner and pairing/encryption because Device Information characteristics are created with READ_ENC.

tests.description: BLE WiFi scan returns at most 30 unique networks, strongest signal kept, paginated 3-per-notify
tests.expected_result: On BLE scan request the device runs WiFi.scanNetworks(), filters out empty SSIDs and RSSI < −75, deduplicates by SSID keeping the strongest entry, sorts by RSSI descending, then sends up to 30 results back as BLE notifications in pages of 3. Each page JSON includes wifi[], page, tpage, found.
tests.notes: Requires: BLE phone + a small RF environment so scan results are countable. Code scans up to 50 raw entries, filters empty SSIDs and RSSI < -75, deduplicates by SSID keeping strongest, sorts by RSSI, then returns at most 30 results in pages of 3.

tests.description: BLE credentials submit retries on failure without disconnecting the BLE session
tests.expected_result: After credentials are written to the BLE characteristic, the device tries to connect for up to 30 s. On failure: log "Failed connect to WiFi", BLE notify PROV_ERR_WIFI_CONNECT_FAILED, OLED shows WiFi connect failed, then after a 3 s indicator the device returns to the BLE provisioning state (LED "WiFiManagerPortalActive") so the tester can submit again without disconnecting BLE.
tests.notes: Requires: BLE phone + induced fail (wrong password). Repeat the submit-and-fail loop a few times to confirm no leak and no premature reboot.

tests.description: BLE pushes provisioning-flow status notifications at each stage
tests.expected_result: After a successful submit, the BLE characteristic emits a sequence of {"status": N} JSON notifications: PROV_WIFI_CONNECT (WiFi up) → PROV_CONNECTING_TO_SERVER → PROV_SERVER_REACHABLE or PROV_ERR_SERVER_UNREACHABLE → PROV_MONITOR_CONFIGURED, PROV_ERR_MONITOR_NOT_REGISTERED, or PROV_ERR_GET_MONITOR_CONFIG_FAILED. On WiFi-only failure, only PROV_ERR_WIFI_CONNECT_FAILED is sent.
tests.notes: Requires: BLE phone capable of subscribing to notifications on the BLE_CRED_CHAR_UUID characteristic. Full status sequence assumes cloud connection is enabled and post/config flows run; if disableCloudConnection=true, server/config notifications after PROV_WIFI_CONNECT are skipped.

tests.description: Either AP portal or BLE wins; the other path is stopped on first client
tests.expected_result: If a phone joins the WiFi AP first: log "Stopping BLE since wifi is connected", BLE server stops, provisionMethod=WiFi. If a BLE client connects first: log "Stopping portal because BLE connected", WiFi config portal stops, provisionMethod=BLE. The 180s portal timeout applies to the WiFi AP portal path; after BLE wins, the BLE provisioning loop continues while the BLE client remains connected.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + ability to trigger either WiFi-AP join or BLE connect on demand. Exercise both directions in a single test session.

tests.description: AT command debug stream is printed during cellular initialization at boot
tests.expected_result: After cellular path selection and operator-state restore, but before agClient->begin(), AT debug is enabled via agSerial->setDebug(true). AT traffic during cellular begin() is mirrored to the serial log. After successful registration and operator-state save, debug is disabled via agSerial->setDebug(false).
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular module + working SIM. The debug stream is the only way to inspect the registration handshake at runtime.

tests.description: SIM ICCID is retrieved and logged at boot
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "SIM CCID: <iccid>" once during begin(). The ICCID value is stored on the cellular client and later used to build the OTA URL.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + SIM card present. If the SIM is missing or unresponsive the log shows "SIM is not ready, please check if SIM is inserted properly!" and begin() fails.

tests.description: Boot network registration is requested as LTE (CNMP=38)
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows the AT command "+CNMP=38" being sent during begin(). The boot path calls startNetworkRegistration(CellTechnology::LTE, ...) — there is no automatic 2G fallback at boot.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + AT debug visible. 2G/Auto modes (+CNMP=13, +CNMP=2) only appear in registration-status probing, not in the actual mode set at boot.

tests.description: Boot registration aborts after the 3-minute timeout if no network attaches
tests.expected_result: If network registration cannot complete within the default 3 minutes (_networkRegistrationTimeoutMs = 180000 ms), begin() returns false. ONE_INDOOR shows "Client / initialization / failed" for 5 seconds, then the rebooting screen, then ESP.restart() is called. OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR has no OLED, so verification is serial-log / reboot based.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular module without service (SIM out, or in a Faraday cage). The old verification template referenced 5 minutes; the current code uses 3 minutes.

tests.description: Saved operator list and operator id are restored before registration at boot
tests.expected_result: If the config has a previously saved operator list, serial log shows "Restored operator state: id=<u>, list=<json>" before the registration handshake. If no list is saved, log shows "No saved operator state to restore" and registration proceeds with a fresh scan.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + a previously successful cellular boot (which calls saveOperatorState). The persistence skips a fresh +COPS scan on subsequent boots, shortening time-to-online.

tests.description: Operator state is saved after every successful registration
tests.expected_result: After successful begin() at boot, serial log shows "Saved operator state: id=<u>, list=<json>" and the value is written to persistent config. The same save also happens after a successful reconnection inside the network task.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular registration succeeding. Confirm persistence by observing the next boot's serial log for "Restored operator state: id=..." which proves the save from the previous session survived.

tests.description: When client becomes not-ready, retry every 30s with module reset
tests.expected_result: Network task logs "Cellular client not ready, ensuring connection...". For the first hour after detection, each attempt calls ensureClientConnection(true) which resets the module (cell_->reset() or power cycle as fallback), waits 10 seconds, reinitializes, then retries LTE registration. On failure: log "Cellular client connection not ready, retry in 30s..." and waits 30 s before the next attempt.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + induced fault (pull SIM after registration). AT debug is re-enabled while the client is not-ready.

tests.description: After 1 hour of not-ready, every retry power-cycles the cellular module
tests.expected_result: Once the problem has persisted longer than TIME_TO_START_POWER_CYCLE_CELLULAR_MODULE (1 hour), the recovery branch logs "The CE client hasn't recovered in more than 1 hour, performing a power cycle". cellularCard->powerOff() runs, 2 s delay, powerOn(), 10 s delay, then ensureClientConnection(false). The 30 s inter-retry wait still applies on failure.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + induced fault held for > 1 hour. Long-soak fixture.

tests.description: After 2 hours of not-ready, device reboots itself
tests.expected_result: Once the problem has persisted longer than TIMEOUT_WAIT_FOR_CELLULAR_MODULE_READY (2 hours), restartIfCeClientIssueOverTwoHours() logs "Rebooting because CE client issues for 2 hours detected". On ONE_INDOOR, OLED shows "CE error / since 2h / Rebooting in N" countdown 3→2→1, then the display is blanked and ESP.restart() is called.
tests.notes: Requires: cellular module + induced fault held for > 2 hours. Long-soak fixture. OLED message is ONE_INDOOR only; Open Air just logs and reboots.

tests.description: Cellular OTA request includes the SIM ICCID as a URL parameter
tests.expected_result: When the cellular OTA flow builds the firmware-check URL, the query string ends with "&offset=0&length=0&iccid=<iccid>" where <iccid> is the value retrieved at boot. The same ICCID stays for the lifetime of the boot session.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log of the OTA HTTP request. The ICCID is the server-side hint for cellular OTA bucketing and resume support.

tests.description: Boot prompt allows toggling offline mode on or off, with the setting persisted
tests.expected_result: After the LED-test prompt (if not pressed), OLED shows "Press now for" / "offline mode" when currently online, or "Press now for" / "online mode" when currently offline. Pressing the button within 3 seconds toggles the state. OLED confirms "Offline Mode" / "= True" or "= False". The new value is saved to persistent config (survives reboot). If no press within 3 seconds, the current mode is kept.
tests.notes: ONE_INDOOR only. The toggle uses setOfflineMode() and saves the value to persistent config (SPIFFS-backed config on ESP32). After toggling to offline, network initialization is skipped and the networking task is never created.

tests.description: Short-press during LED-test prompt enters offline mode for the current session only (not persisted)
tests.expected_result: A short press during the "Press now for LED test" prompt runs the LED test. If the button is released before the test completes, firmware sets offline mode via setOfflineModeWithoutSave(true). The networking task is not started, and the setting is not written to persistent config. On next reboot, the device returns to the previously persisted offline-mode setting.
tests.notes: Keep this distinct from the long-press path: if the button remains pressed after the LED test completes, firmware enters the airgradient/cleanair WiFi path and reboots.

tests.description: In offline mode the networking task is never created — no server traffic runs
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "Running monitor in offline mode". No log lines for POST measures, fetch config, OTA check, or reconnection appear. Sensor polling, display refresh, and LED bar continue to operate normally.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. The networkingTask xTaskCreate call is guarded by isOfflineMode()==false. Sensors and display run in the main loop, independent of networking.

tests.description: In offline mode the dashboard always renders with the plane icon, ignoring network-fault states
tests.expected_result: updateDisplayAndLedBar() detects isOfflineMode() and calls displayHandle/handleLeds with AgStateMachineNormal. The dashboard shows the plane icon (DashBoardStatusOfflineMode). No cloud-fail, WiFi-fail, or config-fail icons appear because the network-status logic is skipped.
tests.notes: Cross-reference: oled.status-icon.offline-mode (Category 2) tests the plane icon itself. This test verifies that the state-machine routing suppresses all other status icons.

tests.description: Exiting persisted offline mode requires a reboot and pressing the button at the boot prompt
tests.expected_result: From a persisted offline-mode session, reboot the device. The boot prompt shows "Press now for" / "online mode". Press the button within 3 seconds; OLED confirms "Offline Mode" / "= False". The device then proceeds to network initialization and, if network setup succeeds, creates the networking task.
tests.notes: There is no runtime path to exit persisted offline mode without a reboot. Session-only offline mode from the LED-test short press does not require this toggle; it clears automatically on reboot unless offline mode was already persisted.

tests.description: Device is discoverable via mDNS with _airgradient._tcp service and TXT records
tests.expected_result: An mDNS browser (e.g. avahi-browse -r _airgradient._tcp) shows the device with hostname airgradient_<deviceId>.local on port 80. TXT records contain: model=<firmware-model string>, serialno=<deviceId>, fw_ver=<firmware version>, vendor=AirGradient.
tests.notes: Requires: same LAN as the device + mDNS browser. mDNS is registered once during initializeNetwork() on WiFi. Not available on cellular.

tests.description: Device responds to ping at airgradient_<deviceId>.local
tests.expected_result: Running `ping airgradient_<deviceId>.local` from a machine on the same LAN gets ICMP replies from the device's IP address.
tests.notes: Requires: same LAN. Confirms mDNS hostname resolution is working end-to-end.

tests.description: GET /config returns the current device configuration as JSON
tests.expected_result: HTTP GET to airgradient_<deviceId>.local/config returns 200 with Content-Type application/json. Response contains current config fields. On ONE_INDOOR, model is the stored config value, often empty. On OPEN_AIR_OUTDOOR, model is injected from current fwMode. ONE-only fields such as ledBarMode, ledBarBrightness, and displayBrightness may be absent on Open Air.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman on the same LAN. Read-only fields (offlineMode, disableCloudConnection) are visible but cannot be changed via PUT.

tests.description: PUT /config applies configuration changes and returns success or failure
tests.expected_result: HTTP PUT to /config with a valid recognized JSON config change (e.g. {"temperatureUnit":"f"}) returns 200 with body "Success"; the change takes effect immediately where applicable. Invalid JSON or invalid value/type for a recognized field returns 400 with config.getFailedMessage(). Unknown fields may be ignored and still return "Success".
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman. Local PUT is only accepted when configurationControl is local or both. If already cloud, local PUT returns 400 with the cloud-only message, except a PUT that changes configurationControl away from cloud is handled by config parsing and can succeed.

tests.description: GET /measures/current returns the latest sensor readings as JSON
tests.expected_result: HTTP GET to /measures/current returns 200 with Content-Type application/json. Body includes wifi, boot, bootCount, serialno, firmware, and model; ONE_INDOOR also includes ledMode. Sensor fields (rco2, pm01, pm02, pm10, pm003Count, atmp, rhum, tvocIndex, tvocRaw, noxIndex, noxRaw, etc.) are included only when the respective sensor is present and the value is valid. Display settings do not affect units: local JSON uses Celsius and ug/m3.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman on same LAN. pm02Compensated, atmpCompensated, and rhumCompensated are local-server compensated fields and may be present even when correction config is none, if the required raw inputs are valid.

tests.description: Compensated fields in /measures/current reflect active correction algorithms
tests.expected_result: /measures/current exposes compensated fields when the required source values are valid. Enabling PM/temperature/humidity correction changes the compensated calculation path; compare compensated fields against raw fields allowing for rounding, and do not require them to differ in every sample.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + active correction settings. Cross-check by PUTting a correction to /config, waiting one refresh, then re-fetching /measures/current. Compensated fields may be present even with correction set to none.

tests.description: Dual-PM Open Air modes (O-1PPT / O-1PP) include two PM channels in /measures/current
tests.expected_result: In dual-PM Open Air modes (O-1PPT / O-1PP), /measures/current includes averaged top-level PM values and nested per-channel data under channels["1"] and channels["2"] for all available PM, temperature, humidity, and compensated fields. Single-channel modes (O-1PST, O-1PS, O-1P) report only one set of PM fields without channels nesting.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + an Open Air unit in a dual-PM mode. The measures.toString(true, fwMode, ...) call selects the payload shape based on fwMode.

tests.description: GET /metrics returns sensor data in OpenMetrics / Prometheus format
tests.expected_result: HTTP GET to /metrics returns 200 with Content-Type "application/openmetrics-text; version=1.0.0; charset=utf-8". The body contains HELP/TYPE/UNIT headers and metric lines for: airgradient_info (serial, device type, version), config_ok, post_ok, wifi_rssi_dbm, plus per-sensor metrics (pm1, pm2d5, pm10, pm0d3, tvoc_index, tvoc_raw, nox_index, nox_raw, co2_ppm, temperature_celsius, temperature_compensated_celsius, humidity_percent, humidity_compensated_percent). Ends with "# EOF". Metrics for absent sensors are omitted entirely.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman. Useful for Prometheus/Grafana scraping. The config_ok and post_ok fields reflect the last fetch-config and post-measures success status.

tests.description: Local server and mDNS are only available when using WiFi network option
tests.expected_result: When the device boots with WiFi, mDNS is registered and the local HTTP server starts (log "Init: airgradient_<id>.local"). When the device boots with cellular, no mDNS and no local server are started — the endpoints are unreachable.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log to confirm init vs. no-init. localServer.begin() and mdnsInit() are only called inside the WiFi branch of initializeNetwork().

tests.description: On WiFi, measures are posted to the AG server every 60 seconds
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows POST measures executing on a 60-second schedule (WIFI_TRANSMISSION_INTERVAL). Each POST increments the boot/bootCount field and includes all valid sensor readings plus WiFi RSSI. Log line prints the full payload JSON.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + WiFi + postDataToAirGradient=true. If postDataToAirGradient is false, the schedule callback logs "Skipping transmission of data to AG server" and resets the post-measures status.

tests.description: On WiFi, configuration is fetched from the AG server every 60 seconds
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows fetch-config GET executing on a 60-second schedule (WIFI_SERVER_CONFIG_SYNC_INTERVAL). Response is parsed and applied if changed. If configurationControl is local, the schedule logs "Ignore fetch server configuration, configurationControl set to local" and skips.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + WiFi + configurationControl = cloud or both.

tests.description: WiFi signal strength is logged every 10 seconds
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "WiFi RSSI <N>" every 10 seconds while AG-server networking schedules are active. On cellular, the equivalent schedule logs the cellular signal quality when signal retrieval succeeds and CSQ is not 99. If disableCloudConnection=true, the networking task skips this schedule.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. The signal value is also included in POST payloads and /measures/current.

tests.description: When MQTT is configured on WiFi, measures are published every 60 seconds
tests.expected_result: When mqttBrokerUrl is non-empty and WiFi is the network option, a dedicated MQTT task publishes to topic "airgradient/readings/<deviceId>" every 60 seconds (MQTT_SYNC_INTERVAL). The payload is the same local-server measures JSON (toString(true, fwMode, RSSI)). Serial log shows "MQTT sync success" or "MQTT sync failure".
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + MQTT broker reachable from the device's LAN. MQTT is not available for cellular (log: "MQTT not available for cellular options").

tests.description: On cellular, a measurement cycle is captured every 3 minutes and added to the queue
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "New measurement cycle added to queue" every 3 minutes (CELLULAR_MEASUREMENT_INTERVAL = 180000 ms). Each cycle captures the current sensor values plus the cellular signal strength converted to RSSI via csqToDbm().
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular network. The queue accumulates cycles until the transmission condition is met.

tests.description: On cellular, measures are posted when the queue size is divisible by 3
tests.expected_result: The transmission schedule runs every 3 minutes (CELLULAR_TRANSMISSION_INTERVAL). On each run, postUsingCellular checks if measurementCycleQueue.size() % 3 == 0. If not, log "Not ready to transmit, queue size are <N>". If divisible, a CSV payload is built from all queued cycles (interval in seconds + per-cycle fields) and POSTed. On success, the queue is cleared.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular. Because measurement and transmission intervals are both 3 min, the queue typically hits size 1 at each transmission window. The divisible-by-3 condition means the first automatic transmission fires after 3 cycles (9 min), unless forcePost is used (boot POST).

tests.description: On cellular, configuration is fetched from the AG server every 30 minutes
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows fetch-config executing on a 30-minute schedule (CELLULAR_SERVER_CONFIG_SYNC_INTERVAL = 1800000 ms). Same parsing and configurationControl checks as WiFi.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + cellular. The longer interval reduces cellular data usage.

tests.description: Values shown on the AirGradient dashboard match the payload that was POSTed
tests.expected_result: For WiFi, compare the serial log PAYLOAD JSON against dashboard readings for the same POST timestamp; valid sensor fields, WiFi RSSI, and boot/bootCount should correspond, allowing for dashboard-side conversions such as AQI. For cellular, compare the posted CSV measurement-cycle payload fields against dashboard readings; cellular payload does not include bootCount.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + dashboard access. Best checked immediately after a POST to avoid stale-cache mismatches.

tests.description: When extendedPmMeasures is enabled, extra PM fields are included in the POST payload
tests.expected_result: On cellular, when extendedPmMeasures=true, extra PM particle-count and standard-particle fields are appended to each CSV measurement cycle. On WiFi, extendedPmMeasures does not change measurements.toString(); JSON PM fields are included based on sensor availability/validity regardless of the flag.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + extendedPmMeasures enabled in the server config. Cellular-specific: compare CSV payload with and without the flag.

tests.description: When disableCloudConnection is true, all AG server traffic is suppressed
tests.expected_result: With disableCloudConnection=true on WiFi, boot POST, config fetch, scheduled transmission, and OTA are skipped; local server endpoints and MQTT still function. At runtime, the networking task skips config/transmission/OTA schedules. On cellular, note current code still performs the initial boot httpFetchConfig() unless configurationControl=local; scheduled traffic is skipped afterward.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + disableCloudConnection set via the WiFi portal checkbox. The flag overrides both configurationControl and postDataToAirGradient.

tests.description: OTA availability is checked every 1 hour
tests.expected_result: After the initial boot OTA check, the checkForUpdateSchedule fires every 60 minutes (FIRMWARE_CHECK_FOR_UPDATE_MS = 3600000 ms). Serial log shows the OTA check initiating and its outcome at each interval.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + network. Boot OTA check is covered in boot.first-server-comm.ota-check. This test verifies the recurring schedule.

tests.description: OTA check is skipped when cloud connection is disabled
tests.expected_result: When disableCloudConnection=true, the networking task skips OTA scheduling and no OTA server request is made. If checkForFirmwareUpdate() is invoked directly, it logs "Cloud connection is disabled, skip firmware update" and returns without contacting the server.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + disableCloudConnection=true. The skip happens at the networking-task loop level, not inside the OTA function itself during normal runtime.

tests.description: When no update is available, the result is AlreadyUpToDate
tests.expected_result: ONE_INDOOR OLED shows "Firmware Update" / "up to date" for ~2.5 seconds. Open Air serial log shows "Firmware update: up to date". No reboot occurs.
tests.notes: Requires: device already running the latest firmware version for its server-side bucket.

tests.description: When an update is available, the device downloads it and reboots on success
tests.expected_result: Starting: ONE_INDOOR shows "Firmware Update" / "New version" / current fwNewVersion value (current code leaves this value empty unless populated elsewhere). Open Air logs "New firmware: <value>". InProgress: ONE_INDOOR shows "Updating... N%"; Open Air logs "Firmware update: N%". Success: code logs "OTA update performed, restarting ...", then counts down "Rebooting... 2", "1", "0" (1 s each), and calls esp_restart().
tests.notes: Requires: a newer firmware binary staged on the OTA server for this device. After reboot, verify the new version via boot log or /measures/current firmware field.

tests.description: When OTA download fails, the device shows failure and retries at the next hourly check
tests.expected_result: ONE_INDOOR OLED shows "Firmware Update" / "fail, will retry" for ~2.5 seconds. Open Air logs "Error: Firmware update: failed". The device does NOT reboot; it continues normal operation and will retry at the next hourly OTA check.
tests.notes: Requires: inducing an OTA failure (e.g. kill the server mid-download, corrupt the binary). On cellular, SGP41 is resumed after the failure. Some early WiFi failures (HTTP init/open or OTA init path) may return Failed without a display callback in current code.

tests.description: When the server returns an unexpected code, OTA is skipped
tests.expected_result: ONE_INDOOR OLED shows "Firmware Update" / "skipped" for ~2.5 seconds. Open Air logs "Firmware update: Skipped". No reboot. Normal operation continues.
tests.notes: Requires: the OTA server returning a non-200/non-304 response (e.g. 500, 403). The Skipped result covers any server response that isn't a clear update or up-to-date.

tests.description: When httpDomain is configured, OTA uses the custom domain for the firmware check
tests.expected_result: When httpDomain is non-empty, OTA calls updateIfAvailable(..., httpDomain.c_str()) and builds the firmware URL with that domain. Serial log shows "httpDomain configuration available, start OTA with custom domain" but does not include the domain string itself. When httpDomain is empty, OTA uses the default AirGradient server.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + httpDomain set via /config PUT or cloud. Confirms the same httpDomain used by agclient for config/measures also drives OTA.

tests.description: Changing ledBarMode at runtime immediately changes the LED bar display
tests.expected_result: PUT {"ledBarMode":"co2"} (or pm / iaqs / off) to /config. The LED bar switches to the new mode within one display-refresh tick (2500 ms). Mode off disables the bar (setEnable(false)). Switching from off to co2/pm/iaqs re-enables the bar at the current brightness.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman on same LAN. LED-mode visual behaviour is detailed in led.mode.* tests (Category 3). This test verifies the runtime-change path, not the steady-state appearance.

tests.description: Changing ledBarBrightness at runtime adjusts the LED bar brightness
tests.expected_result: PUT {"ledBarBrightness":50} to /config. The LED bar brightness changes immediately. Setting brightness to 0 disables the bar (setEnable(false)). Setting brightness > 0 re-enables if ledBarMode is not off.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman. Brightness range is 0–100.

tests.description: Changing displayBrightness at runtime adjusts the OLED display brightness
tests.expected_result: PUT {"displayBrightness":50} to /config. The OLED brightness changes immediately via oledDisplay.setBrightness(). Range is 0–100; 0 turns the display off.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + visual check on the OLED.

tests.description: Changing temperatureUnit switches the displayed unit between °C and °F
tests.expected_result: PUT {"temperatureUnit":"f"} to /config. The OLED temperature header switches to Fahrenheit with the °F suffix. PUT {"temperatureUnit":"c"} switches back. Conversion is display-only; /measures/current and POST payloads remain in Celsius.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + OLED observation. Accepts c, C, f, or F.

tests.description: Changing pmStandard switches the PM2.5 display between ug/m3 and US AQI
tests.expected_result: PUT {"pmStandard":"us-aqi"} to /config. The OLED PM2.5 column switches to the AQI conversion with unit label "AQI". PUT {"pmStandard":"ugm3"} switches back to raw concentration with label "ug/m³".
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + OLED observation. Only affects the display and LED bar; /measures/current always reports raw ug/m3.

tests.description: Changing abcDays updates the S8 automatic baseline calibration period
tests.expected_result: PUT {"abcDays":14} to /config. If the new value differs from the current S8 period, the firmware sets the new ABC period on the S8 and logs "Setting S8 from <old> days to <new> days successful" (or failure). Setting abcDays to 0 disables ABC (logs "off").
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + S8 CO2 sensor present. The ABC period is stored on the S8 itself and survives power cycles.

tests.description: Changing tvocLearningOffset or noxLearningOffset reinitializes the SGP41
tests.expected_result: PUT {"tvocLearningOffset":24} or {"noxLearningOffset":24} to /config. If the value differs from the current offset, the firmware calls sgp41.end() followed by sgp41Init() with the new offset. Serial log shows "Setting tvocLearningOffset from <old> to <new> hours successful" (or nox equivalent).
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + SGP41 present. The reinit temporarily interrupts TVOC/NOx readings until the sensor stabilises.

tests.description: Changing mqttBrokerUrl reconnects the MQTT client to the new broker
tests.expected_result: PUT {"mqttBrokerUrl":"mqtt://192.168.0.18:1883"} to /config. If the URI differs from the current one, the old MQTT client is torn down and a new connection is established. Serial log shows "Successfully connected to MQTT broker" (or failure). Setting to empty string disconnects and disables MQTT.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + reachable MQTT broker on the LAN. MQTT is WiFi-only; cellular logs "MQTT not available for cellular options".

tests.description: Changing httpDomain redirects AG client and OTA traffic to the custom domain
tests.expected_result: PUT {"httpDomain":"custom.example.com"} to /config. The firmware applies agClient->setHttpDomain() and serial log shows "HTTP domain name set to: custom.example.com". Subsequent fetch-config, post-measures, and OTA requests target that domain. Setting to empty string reverts to the default AirGradient domain.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. The domain change takes effect on the next scheduled request, not retroactively.

tests.description: Setting postDataToAirGradient to false disables scheduled measure POSTs
tests.expected_result: PUT {"postDataToAirGradient":false} to /config. On the next transmission-schedule tick, the callback logs "Skipping transmission of data to AG server, post data to server disabled" and resets the post-measures status. Setting to true re-enables POSTs.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Does not affect fetch-config or OTA; those are controlled by configurationControl and disableCloudConnection respectively.

tests.description: configurationControl determines which config source is authoritative
tests.expected_result: When set to "local": fetch-config from AG server is skipped (log "Ignore fetch server configuration, configurationControl set to local"); local PUT is accepted. When set to "cloud": local PUT returns 400 unless changing configurationControl itself; cloud config is fetched on schedule. When set to "both": both local PUT and cloud fetch are accepted.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + curl/Postman. Changing from cloud to local/both via local PUT is the only local PUT accepted when currently cloud.

tests.description: Setting co2CalibrationRequested=true triggers a CO2 baseline calibration
tests.expected_result: PUT {"co2CalibrationRequested":true} to /config. The firmware runs the calibration routine: OLED shows a countdown ("Start CO2 calib" / "after N sec"), then success or failure message. Serial log shows "CO2 Calibration" and the outcome. The flag is consumed after the calibration runs.
tests.notes: Requires: curl/Postman + S8 present. The sensor should be in clean air (400 ppm baseline) for the calibration to be meaningful.

tests.description: When a sensor value becomes invalid at runtime, the OLED shows '-' for that measurement
tests.expected_result: When a sensor stops responding or returns invalid data past its max-period threshold, the measurement average becomes invalid. The OLED dashboard shows "-" for each affected field: CO2 in ppm, PM2.5, VOC, NOx, and "-°C"/"-°F"/"-%" for temp/humidity. Other sensor values continue to display normally.
tests.notes: Max-period thresholds determine how many consecutive missed reads trigger invalidation. The max-period is calculated as (measurementInterval * 0.2) / sensorUpdateInterval. Reproduce by disconnecting a sensor cable at runtime.

tests.description: Invalid sensor values are omitted from POST payloads and /measures/current
tests.expected_result: When a sensor value is invalid, its field is omitted from the JSON POST payload and from /measures/current. The POST still includes all other valid fields. Serial log PAYLOAD printout shows the missing field.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + curl to /measures/current. Each sensor type has its own validity check (isValidCO2, isValidPm, isValidVOC, etc.).

tests.description: Sensor values recover automatically when the sensor resumes valid reads
tests.expected_result: After a period of invalid reads, when the sensor starts returning valid data again, the measurement average is recomputed and the value reappears on the OLED (ONE_INDOOR), in /measures/current, and in POST payloads. No reboot is required.
tests.notes: Reproduce by reconnecting a sensor cable that was previously pulled. Recovery is automatic on the next successful read cycle.

tests.description: WiFi auto-reconnects every 10 seconds when the link is lost
tests.expected_result: When WiFi disconnects at runtime, wifiConnector.handle() calls WiFi.reconnect() every 10 seconds. Serial log shows "Re-Connect WiFi" on each attempt. While disconnected, the networking task loop waits (1 s delay per iteration) and skips all server schedules. On reconnect, schedules resume automatically.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. Reproduce by temporarily powering off the AP, then restoring it. OLED and LED bar show the wifi-issue icon/notification during the disconnected period (see Cat 2/3).

tests.description: Holding the back button for 10 seconds during runtime triggers factory reset
tests.expected_result: Press and hold the back button during normal operation. After 2 seconds, ONE_INDOOR OLED shows "Factory reset" / "keep pressed" / "for 8 sec" and the countdown starts (7→6→...→1→0). Open Air logs the countdown to serial. At count 0: WiFi credentials are erased, local config is reset, ONE_INDOOR shows "Factory reset" / "successful" for 3 seconds, then ESP.restart(). If released before count 0, the reset is aborted and the normal dashboard is restored.
tests.notes: Total hold time is ~10 seconds (2 s initial + 8 s countdown). MQTT task is deleted before the WiFi disconnect to avoid accessing freed resources.

tests.description: External watchdog is fed every 60 seconds
tests.expected_result: Serial log shows "External watchdog feed!" every 60 seconds (watchdogFeedSchedule period = 60000 ms). If the main loop hangs and the watchdog is not fed, the external watchdog hardware eventually resets the device.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. The watchdog is initialized at boot via ag->watchdog.begin(). This is a hardware-level safety net.

tests.description: OLED display brightness is set from config at boot
tests.expected_result: During boot, after the warming-up screen, the firmware applies the configured displayBrightness value. Serial log shows "Display brightness: <N>". The OLED brightness visually matches the configured level.
tests.notes: Requires: OLED + serial log. Value range 0–100. Change via /config PUT or cloud.

tests.description: When satellites config is enabled at boot, the BLE scanner is initialized
tests.expected_result: If satellites are enabled in the config at boot time, serial log shows "Satellites enabled on boot". The AgSatellites object is created, and the BLE scanner is lazy-initialized on the first run() call with NimBLE.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + satellites config enabled via cloud. Satellites is a NimBLE scan feature; it coexists with WiFi.

tests.description: Satellites can be enabled at runtime via config change without reboot
tests.expected_result: When a config update enables satellites at runtime and the feature was not previously active, serial log shows "Satellites enabled on runtime". The AgSatellites object is created, and BLE scanning begins on the next main-loop iteration.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + runtime config change. The satellites flag is checked by configUpdateHandle() on each config update.

tests.description: BLE scan runs in 30-second windows, restarting automatically
tests.expected_result: The BLE scan runs for 30 seconds (_pScan->start(30, false)). When the scan completes, the next run() call checks isScanning() == false and restarts a new 30-second window. Scan parameters: interval=100 ms, window=99 ms, active scan enabled.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log. The scan runs in the main loop via satellites->run(). Continuous scanning as long as satellites remain enabled.

tests.description: Satellite BTHome advertising data is parsed and included in POST payloads
tests.expected_result: When a configured satellite MAC is detected, its BTHome v2 advertising payload is decoded for temperature (obj 0x02) and humidity (obj 0x03). Serial log shows "Satellite <mac> reported temp X.X, hum X.X, rssi N". The data appears in /measures/current and POST payloads under a satellites object keyed by MAC address, with atmp, rhum, and wifi fields. Satellites with empty IDs, stale data (useCount >= 2), or invalid temp/hum are excluded.
tests.notes: Requires: serial log + a BTHome v2 satellite device (e.g. Shelly H&T) with its MAC address configured in the satellites list. Encrypted BTHome payloads are not supported.

tests.description: CO2 sensor shows valid raw values close to reference in a test chamber
tests.expected_result: With a calibrated CO2 reference instrument in the same test chamber, the S8 raw CO2 readings (visible on OLED and /measures/current rco2) are within the sensor's specified tolerance of the reference value.
tests.notes: Requires: test chamber + calibrated reference CO2 analyzer. S8 specified accuracy is ±40 ppm or ±3% of reading. Run after ABC calibration.

tests.description: PM sensor shows valid raw values close to reference in a test chamber
tests.expected_result: With a calibrated PM reference instrument in the same test chamber, the PMS5003/SPS30 raw PM2.5 readings (visible on OLED and /measures/current pm02) track the reference within the sensor's specified tolerance.
tests.notes: Requires: test chamber + calibrated reference PM analyzer. PMS5003 accuracy varies by particle source; use standardized test aerosol.

tests.description: SGP41 sensor shows valid VOC/NOx index values in a test chamber
tests.expected_result: With a known VOC/NOx source in a test chamber, the SGP41 TVOC and NOx index readings (visible on OLED and /measures/current tvocIndex, noxIndex) respond to the stimulus and return to baseline after removal. The index algorithm produces monotonically increasing values as VOC/NOx concentration rises.
tests.notes: Requires: test chamber + VOC/NOx source. Allow 12+ hours of conditioning time for the SGP41 learning algorithm to stabilise before reference testing.

tests.description: SHT sensor shows valid temperature and humidity values close to reference
tests.expected_result: With a calibrated temperature/humidity reference in the same test chamber, the SHT raw readings (visible on OLED header and /measures/current atmp, rhum) are within the sensor's specified tolerance of the reference values.
tests.notes: Requires: test chamber + calibrated reference T/RH instrument. SHT4x specified accuracy: ±0.2°C for temperature, ±1.8% for humidity.
